mapper.sql: from crm_opty o left join sys_user u on u.user_id = o.user_id left join sys_dept d on u.dept_id = d.dept_id
mapper.select:
select o.stage as stage_key, COUNT(*)::bigint as cnt, COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(o.amount, 0)), 0) as stage_amount
group by o.stage order by cnt desc
mapper.sql: from crm_task t left join sys_user u on u.user_id = t.user_id left join sys_dept d on u.dept_id = d.dept_id
from crm_lead l left join sys_user u on u.user_id = l.user_id left join sys_dept d on u.dept_id = d.dept_id

if.test: dateFrom != null and dateFrom != '' and dateTo != null and dateTo != ''

mapper.select: select COALESCE(SUM(v.booked_total), 0) as booked_total, COALESCE(SUM(v.inflight_total), 0) as inflight_total, COALESCE(SUM(v.refund_total), 0) as refund_total, COALESCE(SUM(v.net_clv), 0) as net_clv, COALESCE(SUM(v.paid_total), 0) as paid_total, COUNT(*)::bigint as account_count from crm_account_value v inner join crm_account a on a.account_id = v.account_id left join sys_user u on u.user_id = a.user_id left join sys_dept d on u.dept_id = d.dept_id where v.del_flag = '0' and a.org_id = #{filterOrgId} and a.account_id = #{filterAccountId} and a.user_id = #{filterOwnerId} ${params.dataScope}
